__comment: Multipart, not variants, so Create's rotation_speed_controller model can be used EXACTLY as it ships - referenced by path, never copied - and our overlay is layered on top as a second model. A child model cannot add elements to its parent, so layering is the only way to leave Create's geometry untouched. Property is 'axis' (BlockStateProperties.HORIZONTAL_AXIS), not 'horizontal_axis'.
